name: @mpd-dsh/team-watchdog-plugin
description: Team watchdog core: per-step/per-tool heartbeat store (members and captain), the configurable WARN->ESCALATE state machine, the atomic restorable scene snapshot, the durable watchdogHold + incident/watermark sidecars beside team.json, and the plugin's own session-watchdog-hold/-resume actions

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target node --format esm --outfile dist/index.js
